newsitem.title: NORWAY: Awilco says weighs cooperation with PGS.
newsitem.headline: Awilco says weighs cooperation with PGS.

text.p: Norwegian offshore services company Awilco ASA said on Friday it may enter into cooperation with Petroleum Geo-Services ASA (PGS) or some other offshore company.
Awilco said in a statement carried by the Oslo Bourse it had asked Goldman Sachs to look into strategic options for the company's further development.
"The company in this connection is considering cooperation with several different companies, including PGS," the statement said.

Awilco shares closed 4.60 percent up at 91.50 crowns in turnover of 59 million crowns at the bourse on Thursday. It rose after an unconfirmed news report that the company was planning to merge with PGS, another offshore services company.
Financial news magazine Kapital said Awilco and PGS were looking to merge operations this year.
Synergies between the two could be considerable and the merged company would be well prepared for further growth, according to Kapital.
Rumours of a fusion between PGS and Awilco have been circulating in the market. Kapital said representatives from the two companies had used the summer break to work on a solution.
